title: LLMs for Translation: Historical, Low-Resourced Languages and Contemporary AI Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequency, severity, and categories of safety flags (hate speech, dangerous content, harassment, sexually explicit) triggered by Gemini when translating an 18th-century manuscript, highlighting false positives on historical victim narratives and accounts of warfare.
Comparing the translation success rates and safety flag severity scores of Gemini on parallel source texts from a low-resourced language (Ottoman Turkish) versus a high-resourced language (German).
Counterfactual age substitution in test prompts (changing 'fifteen' to 'twenty') to evaluate how safety filters disproportionately block translations of sensitive narratives involving minors.
